pkg.title: One notebook layout for every lab: notebooks/ for what you open, solutions/ for the answers
pkg.scope: Every lab's notebook files and directories outside 06-gateway/llm-gateway/ and 07-application-agent-framework/agent-memory/ (moves with `git mv`), and everything that names those paths: the labs' READMEs, Makefiles, notebook builders (`build_notebooks.py` and siblings), `run_notebooks.py` defaults, `tests/test_notebook_tooling.py` and similar tooling tests, `tools/inject_colab_bootstrap.py` runs (not its code unless a criterion needs it), `tools/gen_colab_index.py` and `tools/site/build_site_content.py` with their tests, `tools/ci/ci.py`, `tools/ci/labs.json`, `tools/ci/run_local.sh` only if a path is hardcoded, `COLAB.md` and the layer READMEs' Colab sections (via the generator), mkdocs.yml (via its generator), CURRICULUM.md/COMPUTE.md/root README.md/layer README lines that name a moved path.
pkg.findings:
DECISION (approved): one notebook layout in every lab. `notebooks/<name>.ipynb` holds what a learner opens — exercise blanks, and lessons or walkthroughs where a lab has them; `solutions/<name>.ipynb` holds the worked answer to a blank, with EXACTLY the same file name as its blank. No other notebook directories (`practice/`, `worked/`, `exercises/`, nested `notebooks/solutions/`, `notebooks/practice/`), and no solution that lives beside its blank under a suffix (`_solved`, `_solutions`, `_solution`, `_worked`). A notebook in `notebooks/` without a twin in `solutions/` is fine (a lesson, or a blank whose answer is in the lab's tests). The review's inventory of today's five conventions is tools/orchestration/reviews/2026-09-26-adversarial-review.md §7, third bullet. Package c1 has already moved the durable lab (`07-application-agent-framework/long-running-durable/lra-gcp`, `lra-core`) to this layout and package c2 folded the Mistral variants — start from current `origin/main`, which has both.

N1 INVENTORY FIRST. Write a small script (keep it in tools/ci/ as the guard of N4) that lists every tracked `.ipynb` (skip `.ipynb_checkpoints`) with its lab, directory role and twin, and prints every deviation from the layout above. Put the before/after table in the PR body. Expected deviations include at least: `06-gateway/identity-security/agentic-identity-core` (flat `core_walkthrough/core_practice/core_solution.ipynb` plus the `core_mistral_*` trio after c2), `06-gateway/identity-security/agentic-identity-gcp-lab` (`notebooks/practice/` + `notebooks/solutions/`), `06-gateway/scaling-admission-cost/agentic-scaling-lab` (`notebooks/solutions/*_solutions.ipynb`), `07-application-agent-framework/retrieval-rag/embeddings-lab` (`exercises/` + `solutions/` + `notebooks/` = worked lessons with saved outputs), `00-foundations/gpu-capacity-planning` (`01_capacity_practice_solved.ipynb` beside its blank), `00-foundations/transformers` (check what its practice builder writes and where the lesson notebooks live), the 04 kernel topics (`flash-attention`, `paged-attention`, `kv-cache`: practice notebooks and companions at the topic root or under other names), `07-application-agent-framework/agent-fundamentals/gcp-agent-platform-lab` and `retrieval-rag/rag-from-scratch`, `vector_stores` (check). Labs already in the layout (layers 01–05 cores and labs, agent-core, the four 2026-09-26 topics, lra-core, lra-gcp after c1) must not be touched.

N2 MOVES. Every move is a `git mv`. A blank keeps its file name; its solution is renamed to that name inside `solutions/`. Lessons and walkthroughs go to `notebooks/` unchanged. embeddings-lab: `exercises/*.ipynb` → `notebooks/` (same names), its lessons stay in `notebooks/`, `solutions/` stays; its `build.py` (which executes lessons and writes outputs — reproducible since PR #29) and `tools/ci/embeddings-lab-build.txt` must still work. gpu-capacity-planning: `01_capacity_practice_solved.ipynb` → `solutions/01_capacity_practice.ipynb`. The identity core: its notebooks move into `notebooks/` and `solutions/` (`core_solution.ipynb` → `solutions/core_practice.ipynb`; `core_walkthrough.ipynb` → `notebooks/`; the Mistral trio likewise). Percent-source labs: change the builder's output directories, not the generated files by hand, then rebuild; hand-written notebooks: re-run `python3 tools/inject_colab_bootstrap.py <lab-dir>` after moving because the Colab cell hardcodes the notebook's directory. Stable cell ids and blank/solution content are unchanged by the move (diff a couple to prove it).

N3 EVERYTHING THAT NAMES A PATH IS UPDATED: READMEs (each lab's "Run it" and notebook tables, the topic and layer READMEs), Makefiles (`check`/`notebooks` targets), `run_notebooks.py` defaults and the labs' `tests/test_notebook_tooling.py`, `tools/ci/labs.json` solutions steps, CURRICULUM.md and COMPUTE.md lines, the root README if it names a path, the site generator's inputs. `python3 tools/orchestration/mdlinks.py` is clean on every changed .md.

N4 GENERATORS AND GUARD. `tools/gen_colab_index.py` and `tools/site/build_site_content.py` drop their special cases for `practice/`, `worked/`, `exercises/`, `_worked`, `_solved`, `_solutions`, nested `notebooks/solutions/` (they were taught all five conventions by the fix plan; now they know one), with their tests updated and a test that a solution is recognised only under `solutions/`; the COLAB.md boilerplate and the layer READMEs' Colab-section boilerplate say the one convention; `tools/ci/ci.py check` gains the N1 guard (fails on any `.ipynb` outside `notebooks/`, `solutions/` or a documented lessons location inside a lab, or on a `solutions/` file without a same-named blank), covered by a test in tools/ci/tests, and `tools/ci/run_local.sh --check` runs it.

N5 CI. `tools/ci/run_local.sh --check`, `--notebooks` (every builder and the injector are no-ops on the committed tree), `--colab-index`, `--docs`, and `tools/ci/run_local.sh <lab-id>` for every lab whose notebooks moved all pass.

N6 NO STALE REFERENCES. `git grep -n -E 'notebooks/(practice|worked|solutions)/|/exercises/|_solved\.ipynb|_solutions\.ipynb|/practice/|/worked/'` over tracked files finds nothing outside CLAUDE.md and tools/orchestration/reviews/ (which you must not edit) — except a documented lessons directory if you kept one and named it in N4's guard.

N7 SCOPE DISCIPLINE. Do not touch `06-gateway/llm-gateway/` or `07-application-agent-framework/agent-memory/` (built in parallel), and do not change any notebook's content beyond what the injector writes.
pkg.verify: In your own fresh venv, from the worktree root: (a) for each kept lab in scope, install it exactly as its README says and run `python3 -m pytest -q` in it; (b) `tools/ci/run_local.sh --check` (lab list complete, CI helpers tested); (c) `tools/ci/run_local.sh <lab-id>` for every lab id in scope that remains in tools/ci/labs.json; (d) `tools/ci/run_local.sh --notebooks` (every builder and the injector are no-ops on your committed tree); (e) `tools/ci/run_local.sh --colab-index`; (f) `tools/ci/run_local.sh --docs` (site generator tests, mkdocs.yml regenerated unchanged, strict mkdocs build, link check over all tracked Markdown) — read the usage comment at the top of tools/ci/run_local.sh first; (g) `python3 tools/orchestration/mdlinks.py <every .md you changed>`; (h) the stale-path grep named in the criteria; (i) `git status --porcelain` is empty after rebuilding notebooks and regenerating. Paste the tail of each result.
pkg.notes: Notebook execution is not needed for a move; the tooling tests and `--notebooks` rebuild check are. Some builders (`00-foundations/transformers/practice/build_notebooks.py`, `long-running-agents-gcp`-style builders, `embeddings-lab/build.py`) import the injector's `make_cell`; keep that. Never install torch (the transformers lab's torch notebooks are not executed here). Do not run `ipykernel install --user`. Merge `origin/main` into your branch before the final push and regenerate rather than hand-merge generated files.
pkg.allow_exceptions: tools/ci/run_local.sh only if a path is hardcoded in it (say so in the PR body).
